disposition: No unresolved blocker found in this bounded UI diff review after fixes. Full DB/browser gate remains root responsibility.

findings.problem: Initial submit per-call error could sign out current employee, erase draft and revoke current session after old lifetime.
findings.reproduction: execute pending; renew same employee object or offline→online; reject AUTH_REQUIRED/EMPLOYEE_SESSION_REQUIRED.
findings.before: 4 stale errors fail; 2 current-error controls pass. After fix 9 tracked cases pass; guard-removal kills 6 stale error/ACK cases.
findings.fix: Root captured view lifetime before mutate and scoped both onSuccess/onError.

findings.problem: Reprint failed read could sign out replacement employee, clear draft and revoke their session.
findings.reproduction: getOrder/getReceipt pending; change employee or offline→online; reject AUTH_REQUIRED/EMPLOYEE_SESSION_REQUIRED.
findings.before: 8/8 stale read scenarios fail through currentEmployee/draft/toast/revoke assertions.
findings.fix: Root guarded reprint catch with captured view lifetime.

findings.problem: Old void callback showed toast/refetched detail; unguarded settlement could release a newer confirmation read busy flag.
findings.reproduction: void execute pending; same employee session renewal or offline→online; late auth error or applied ACK. For settlement, close old popup, renew session, start a new confirmation read, then settle old void.
findings.before: 6 stale callbacks fail. Separate in-memory settlement guard removal kills the new-reading-state oracle.
findings.fix: Root scoped success/error with view plus confirmation generation, and used generation-only cleanup for settlement.
